name: nafissa-platform
description: NAFISSA — monorepo (frontend Vite/React + backend Fastify/Prisma). Déployé en un seul processus : le backend sert le build du frontend.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install --include=dev && npm --prefix backend-node install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm --prefix backend-node run db:generate
